facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation says it is developing a comprehensive Data Governance Framework to establish how government data is classified, shared and used across institutions.
The Minister and team walked the UN delegation through the Government Data Centre at NatCA Tower, with plans outlined for a redundancy site at State House, as reported by Sierra Loaded.
